messages:
sam: @maya quick heads-up — ACME (enterprise) inbound. They want a 6mo commitment for EU+US, 1.2B tokens/month avg, 2.5B peak, and ability to carry unused credits month->month. Wants 99.9% SLA and predictable overage floor. Can we give a pricing grid? :thinking:

maya: thx. need model family, latency SLO, private vs hosted, and if they require burst GPUs vs credits. Any legal constraints?

sam: model: 'redwood-13B' or 'open-14B' compatible. latency target 300ms P95. They prefer hosted but legal asks for data residency EU.

olivia: quick take — three structured offers to propose:
Option A — Committed tokens (monthly credits): low per-token, credits expire end-of-month, overage charged at 1.8x. Example rate: $0.00055/token.
Option B — Reserved capacity (dedicated GPU pool): committed $/month for capacity, includes monthly cushion credits, lower overage $0.00095/token but higher baseline. Example effective token price ~ $0.0009.
Option C — Hybrid smoothing: committed credits + rollover buffer + burst credits. Blended per-token ~ $0.0007 with 20% unused rollover cap.

olivia: attach quick calc:
```
# Monthly usage examples (1.2B avg / 2.5B peak)
A_cost = 1.2e9 * 0.00055 = $660k
B_cost = reserved baseline + variable; approx = $900k baseline -> lower marginal
C_cost = blend -> ~$840k
```

jordan: finance note — we need minimum commitment term and downside protection. Rollover increases revenue risk; cap rollover and set 'use it or lose it' above cap. Also require 30% non-refundable on ramp.

leon: support ops — billing needs: cross-month rollover requires invoice engine change.
billing-bot: "⚠️ FYI: system only supports fixed-credit expiry today; product change required for rollover >30d."

maya: OK — proposal for backlog: create ticket PRD: 'acme-hybrid-pack-v1' with acceptance criteria: doc with pricing options, legal clause for rollover cap, SLA mapping, billing flow, pricing floor and overflow, example customer TCO table, and required infra changes (billing + regional isolation). Owner: @olivia; secondary: @jordan. Priority: P1 for enterprise sales runway.

sam: +1 will align with customer and push for preferred option C. Need a short one-pager for ACME by EOD Friday.

olivia: adding to roadmap backlog and will draft PRD. tagging legal and billing owners. :thumbsup: 

maya: thanks all — leaving note: if rollout requires private deploy, cost delta ~ +15-25%.

sam: noted, will surface. Thanks.
